product.title: Norix Ironman Stack-A-Bunk Bed Platform – B530-151 / B530-149
product.body_html:
The Norix Ironman Stack-A-Bunk Bed Platform is a temporary sleep surface that keeps people off the floor when a facility is overcrowded or needs emergency bunking. Most courts do not allow inmates to sleep on the floor, and the Stack-A-Bunk gives facilities a washable, stackable platform that can be stored until it is needed.

Each platform is rotationally molded in one piece from high-impact polyethylene with UV stabilizers, so it has no moving parts or components that could be turned into a weapon. The seamless, non-porous surface does not absorb fluids, gives bed bugs nowhere to hide, and can be cleaned with bleach solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants. When not in use, 22 platforms stack 72” high.

  • Material: One-piece rotationally molded high-impact polyethylene with UV stabilizers and TruColor™ fully compounded color
  • Chemical Resistance: Resists blood, vinegar, urine, feces, salt solution, and chlorine solution
  • Stacking: 22 platforms stack 72” high for storage
  • Height: 8⅜”
  • Mattress: Use with or without a mattress (sold separately)
  • Flammability Standards: California Technical Bulletin 133 and 117, UL 1056, ASTM E1537, and NFPA 261
  • Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
  • Warranty: 10-year limited replacement warranty
  • Intended Use: Indoor use only
  • Country of Manufacture: USA

Available Models and Options

  • B530-151 – Standard: 32”W×75½”L overall, fits a 25”×67” mattress, Twilight, 30 lbs
  • B530-149 – Extra Large: 32”W×82½”L overall, fits a 25”×75” mattress, Sand, 36 lbs

Installation and Options

  • Assembly: None required

Applications

The Stack-A-Bunk is made for temporary bunking, so facilities can keep platforms in storage and set them up when the population rises.

Typical applications include:

  • Prisons, jails, and detention centers
  • Disaster relief, emergency, mass care, night, and transitional housing shelters
  • Overcrowding and emergency temporary bunking
  • Intake, holding, and other short-term housing areas

About Norix Ironman Detention Series

The Norix Ironman Detention Series includes heavy-duty correctional furniture, fixtures, and equipment designed for prisons, jails, detention centers, and other secure environments. Ironman products emphasize durability, security-conscious design, and low-maintenance construction for demanding institutional use.

The Ironman Series includes:

  • Steel Bunks: Floor-mounted single and double bunks and wall-mounted bunks
  • Temporary Bunks: Stack-A-Bunk stackable sleep surfaces for overcrowding and emergency bunking
  • Seating: Benches with cuff rings for intake and holding areas and floor-mount stools
  • Washroom Accessories: Stainless steel ADA shower seats, grab bars, toilet paper holders, and hooks
  • Property Storage: Tank Box and Citadel inmate property storage boxes with matching lids
